# Pull request visual evidence

These browser captures use synthetic sessions, users, Hosts, paths, and text.
They illustrate filesystem roots and folder shortcuts, inline attachments,
Archive layout, project targeting, native Goal markers, assistant line breaks,
and final-transcript punctuation. No live account or conversation data is used.

PR descriptions link to this commit's immutable image paths. These images are
review evidence; the corresponding code branches contain the implementation
and executable tests. Responsive Chromium captures do not establish physical
iOS or native-harness acceptance.
